intro: The Senate unit makes your entertainment area feel complete. Thoughtfully designed with soft lighting, smart storage, & tidy wire management, it helps create a setup that's both relaxing & stylish.

features.title: A perfect home for your 65-inch TV
features.text: Your entertainment deserves the right setup. With space for TVs up to 65 inches, you get a sleek, clutter-free focal point for movie nights, gaming, or relaxing with your favourite shows.

features.title: Softly lit shelves to showcase what matters
features.text: Built-in lighting adds a warm glow to your décor, books, and collectibles—turning your TV unit into a beautiful display, day or night.

features.title: Push-to-open drawers for effortless storage
features.text: No handles, no hassle. A gentle push gives you access to hidden storage, keeping remotes, wires, and accessories neatly tucked away but always within reach.

features.title: Wire management to keep things neat
features.text: Messy cables take away from a great setup. Thoughtfully designed cable management keeps everything tidy, so all you see is a clean, polished space.

features.title: A modern finish that fits right in
features.text: The rich wood tones paired with soft neutral hues bring warmth and style to your home, making your entertainment area feel as inviting as it looks.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
